archetypes.name: NEAR_TRANSFER
archetypes.purpose: Keep the taught method but change chemistry/context enough to require genuine transfer.

archetypes.name: REVERSED_TARGET
archetypes.purpose: Reverse the direction of an already-taught quantitative or symbolic bridge.

archetypes.name: HIDDEN_INFORMATION
archetypes.purpose: Require inference of an intermediate quantity or chemistry state before the taught routine can be applied.

archetypes.name: REPRESENTATION_SWITCH
archetypes.purpose: Move between particle, structural, symbolic, tabular or quantitative representations.

archetypes.name: ERROR_DIAGNOSIS
archetypes.purpose: Diagnose and repair a chemically meaningful error rather than repeat a standard calculation.

archetypes.name: COMPARE_RANK
archetypes.purpose: Compare or rank chemically related cases using a taught invariant or proportional relation.

archetypes.name: CONDITION_EXCEPTION
archetypes.purpose: Require checking the condition under which a taught rule applies before using it.

archetypes.name: MULTI_STEP_BRIDGE
archetypes.purpose: Chain at least two already-taught chemistry bridges without adding new curricular authority.

archetypes.name: CONSERVATION_RECONSTRUCTION
archetypes.purpose: Recover a missing/incorrect symbolic or particle relation from conservation or charge constraints.

archetypes.name: MIXED_SYNTHESIS
archetypes.purpose: Combine two or more mature taught buckets in one question.
